name: Kansas City
summary: H.O.O.D. Hope's founding metro and organizational headquarters — where the Sustainable Wellness Housing Program was born and where the model is being proven alongside St. Louis.
heroNote: Kansas City is home base — the metro where H.O.O.D. Hope was founded, headquartered at 710 Central Street, and where the 5-Stage Path to Homeownership is being built from the ground up.

localPartner.name: H.O.O.D. Hope Foundation
localPartner.role: Kansas City Direct Operations — Founding Metro

initiatives.title: 5-Stage Path to Homeownership — Kansas City Cohort
initiatives.description: The full Continuum of Care model operating from H.O.O.D. Hope's Kansas City headquarters, moving families from Crisis/Pre-Housing through Ownership/Exit.

initiatives.title: East Side & Prospect Corridor Focus
initiatives.description: Targeting Kansas City's historic East Side and Prospect corridor neighborhoods with high vacancy rates and deep community roots, where affordable housing gaps are most acute.

initiatives.title: Homeownership Academy — KC
initiatives.description: Financial literacy, credit repair, budgeting workshops, and down payment assistance navigation that move families through Stage 2–3 of the Continuum.

initiatives.title: Community Wellness Navigation
initiatives.description: Connecting families to healthcare, behavioral health, and social services as part of the wraparound WEL9 methodology — housing as healthcare.

resources.title: Kansas City Housing Authority
resources.eligibility: Income-eligible Kansas City, MO residents; public housing & Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) waitlists
resources.address: 920 Main St, Suite 701, Kansas City, MO 64105
resources.note: The public housing agency administering Section 8 / Housing Choice Vouchers, public housing, and mixed-income developments for Kansas City, MO.

resources.title: Habitat for Humanity Kansas City
resources.eligibility: Income-eligible families willing to partner in building their home
resources.address: 1423 E Linwood Blvd, Kansas City, MO 64109
resources.note: Builds and repairs affordable homes in the KC metro. Offers homeownership programs, Critical Home Repair, and ReStore operations.

resources.title: Neighborhood Housing Services of Kansas City (NHS)
resources.eligibility: Kansas City metro area residents seeking homeownership or home repair assistance
resources.note: NeighborWorks affiliate providing homebuyer education, down payment assistance, home repair loans, and foreclosure prevention counseling.

resources.title: Westside Housing Organization
resources.eligibility: Low- to moderate-income residents in the Westside and surrounding neighborhoods
resources.note: Community development organization focused on affordable housing, economic opportunity, and community building on the Westside.

resources.title: United Way of Greater Kansas City — Housing Stability
resources.eligibility: Open to KC metro residents; referral-based programs
resources.address: 801 W 47th St, Suite 500, Kansas City, MO 64112
resources.note: Coordinates housing stability initiatives, emergency rental assistance, and community resource navigation across the KC metro.

resources.title: Guadalupe Centers, Inc.
resources.eligibility: Open to all; focus on Latino and underserved communities
resources.address: 1015 Avenida Cesar E. Chavez, Kansas City, MO 64108
resources.note: Comprehensive community services including workforce development, financial coaching, homeownership classes, early education, and charter schools.

resources.title: Local Initiatives Support Corporation (LISC) Greater Kansas City
resources.eligibility: Community organizations and residents in underinvested neighborhoods
resources.address: 818 Grand Blvd, Suite 1100, Kansas City, MO 64106
resources.note: Community development financial institution supporting affordable housing, economic development, and community safety in Kansas City's underinvested neighborhoods.

resources.title: Swope Health Services
resources.eligibility: Open to all; sliding-fee scale available
resources.note: Federally Qualified Health Center providing primary care, dental, behavioral health, pharmacy, and WIC services across multiple Kansas City locations.

resources.title: Samuel U. Rodgers Health Center
resources.eligibility: Open to all; sliding-fee scale for uninsured
resources.note: FQHC providing primary care, dental, behavioral health, and pharmacy services to underserved communities in northeast Kansas City.

resources.title: ReDiscover — Behavioral Health Services
resources.eligibility: Open to all; specializes in uninsured and Medicaid recipients
resources.address: 901 NE Independence Ave, Lee's Summit, MO 64086
resources.note: Comprehensive behavioral health services including substance use treatment, mental health counseling, crisis services, and supported housing.

resources.title: Harvesters — The Community Food Network
resources.eligibility: Open to food-insecure households across the KC region
resources.note: Feeding America member food bank serving 26 counties in northwestern Missouri and northeastern Kansas. Distributes food through 760+ partner agencies.

resources.title: Kansas City Community Gardens
resources.eligibility: Open to all KC metro residents
resources.note: Provides plants, seeds, and education to grow food. Operates community gardens and Giving Grove fruit tree orchards across KC neighborhoods.

resources.title: Kansas City Public Schools — Early Childhood
resources.eligibility: Kansas City, MO children ages 3-5 and their families
resources.note: Free pre-K, early childhood, and family engagement programs. Includes Head Start partnerships and school readiness programs.

resources.title: Kansas City Public Library — Adult Education
resources.eligibility: Open to all KC metro residents
resources.note: Free GED preparation, ESL classes, digital literacy, career services, and homework help. Library cards available regardless of housing status.

resources.title: Full Employment Council
resources.eligibility: Open to all job seekers in the KC metro; priority for underserved communities
resources.note: Workforce development, job training, career placement, youth employment programs, and employer connections for the KC metro area.

resources.title: Urban League of Greater Kansas City
resources.eligibility: Open to all; focus on underserved communities
resources.note: Workforce development, youth education, housing counseling, entrepreneurship training, and community advocacy for economic empowerment.

resources.title: Don Bosco Centers
resources.eligibility: Open to all; focus on immigrant and refugee families
resources.language: English, Spanish, Somali, Swahili, interpretation available
resources.note: Multi-service community center providing immigration legal services, ESL, citizenship classes, after-school programs, and family support.

resources.title: Reconciliation Services
resources.eligibility: Open to all residents in the Midtown/Westport area
resources.note: Wraparound community services including free health clinic, food pantry, clothing, counseling, and case management on the Troost corridor.

resources.title: Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Kansas City
resources.eligibility: Youth ages 6-18; financial assistance available
resources.note: After-school programs, summer camps, mentoring, STEM education, and safe spaces for youth across 16 KC metro locations.

resources.title: 211 Helpline — United Way of Greater Kansas City
resources.eligibility: Open to all residents
resources.note: Free, confidential 24/7 helpline connecting residents to housing, food, utility, and crisis resources across the KC metro.
